The complete author-hosted preprint at https://optimization-online.org/wp-content/uploads/2010/06/2646.pdf was opened and read instead; its successful full-text fetch is recorded above. The exact timestamp of the earlier exploratory attempt is not available in the active handoff, so no timestamp or retry is fabricated.

The browser full-text open timed out. Searches found an official Stanford page with metadata but no full-text body and an alternate result without a complete paper. A direct fetch of the same author-hosted PDF then succeeded; the 125-page complete text was inspected, including §3.2 and Appendix A, and is stamped above. The exact time of the browser timeout and searches is unavailable in the active handoff. Review found that Appendix A proves residual/objective convergence and dual-residual convergence, but not convergence of the whole dual sequence; the assigned theorem supplies that argument.
